name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx hosting for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site content, TLS certificates, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory creation, and cleanup of replication-related configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
